irregularities.title: 48 player(s) have no official designation but do have an ESPN status
irregularities.detail: nfl.com printed a blank Game Status for these players (they practised without a designation), so this site renders them as ACTIVE and marks the designation as inferred. ESPN separately carries a news-derived status. This is a semantic difference between the two sources, NOT a data error, so it is reported once in aggregate rather than once per player.

irregularities.title: 5 reporter claim(s) contradicted by the official report
irregularities.detail: These claims are retained (not deleted) because a contradicted claim is the evidence that drives a reporter's score down. Examples: CBS Sports said QUESTIONABLE for Malik Nabers (official: see link); nyt_sports@robot.villas said OUT for Drew Lock (official: see link); Daniel Flick said QUESTIONABLE for Michael Penix Jr. (official: see link); Kelsey Conway said QUESTIONABLE for Joe Burrow (official: see link); Brianna Dix said QUESTIONABLE for Jacob Parrish (official: see link)
